detail.description:
Welcome to Breezy Bounce, the ultimate sky-high bouncing adventure!

Launch your ball into a beautiful ever-changing sky and bounce from platform to platform while the wind pushes you in every direction. How high can you go?

How to Play:
Tap the left side of the screen to move left and the right side to move right. Your ball bounces automatically when it lands on a platform. Collect gold coins to spend in the shop on new character skins. Grab power-ups to gain temporary abilities like shields,
